text:
jordan: Quick sync deciding pill selector vs dropdown for notification channels in Alerting/SLO panel. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz. Pills show icons but use width; dropdown hides badges. thoughts? emily: Pills if we collapse extras to '+N' and keep icons, users want glanceable channels in preview. marco: Agree but must nail keyboard nav and semantics. Suggest role="listbox" + option semantics. Example: ```
``` emily: Also preview should surface suppression state (snoozed vs muted). Dimmed pill + :zzz: icon + tooltip 'Suppressed until 10:00 UTC'. jordan: Copy tweak: threshold helper from 'percentage of errors' -> 'Percentage of requests failing (last 5m)'. Shorter and clearer. marco: Accessibility: warning color contrast is ~3.1:1 for small text. Will propose palette adjustments to hit 4.5:1. aria-bot: Reminder: preview modal should set role="dialog" and aria-modal="true", trap focus, and announce "Preview of notification payload" using aria-live polite. emily: Mobile nit: stepper too close to label; add 6px left margin under 480px. jordan: Plan: emily updates figma with pill + dropdown variants (EOD), marco opens a11y PR, i'll coordinate palette and rollout notes. Thanks :thumbsup:
